changelog:
🧠 换号主动剥历史 thinking，消灭思考签名 400 风暴：Kiro/AWS 的思考签名是账号绑定的，同账号回放有效、跨账号回放必被上游拒（THINKING_SIGNATURE_INVALID 400，实测 ~167 次/时）。旧行为是发上游撞 400、跨三个端点各撞一次后再由 SelfHeal 剥 reasoning 同账号重试（一次 400 事件≈4 个上游往返）。现在给回传客户端的真实签名打上产出账号的隐私 token（signature_provenance），下一轮在选号后判定：签名产出账号==当前服务账号则保留（有效且命中上游前缀缓存、延续 interleaved thinking），跨账号或无来源标记（外来/历史签名）则在发上游前就剥掉，把 400+重试往返消灭在发生之前。SelfHeal 仍作兜底。据 2026-07-20 只读排查+同账号回放实验实锤：负载分配均衡、粘性命中率 95%，400 的真因是换号回放而非 thinking 块本身。
🎨 管理端/用户端「已禁用」状态徽章统一改红色（新增 .badge-disabled，卡密 .key-tag-disabled 改用 destructive 色板），账号卡、卡密卡、用户中心风格一致。
🧠 Proactively strip cross-account thinking blocks to kill the signature-400 storm: Kiro/AWS thinking signatures are account-bound — replaying to the SAME account is accepted, replaying to a DIFFERENT account is always rejected (THINKING_SIGNATURE_INVALID 400, ~167/h in production). Previously the request hit the 400 (once per each of three endpoints) and only then did SelfHeal strip reasoning and retry on the same account (~4 upstream round-trips per 400 event). Now the real signature relayed to the client is tagged with a privacy-preserving token of the producing account (signature_provenance); on the next turn, after account selection we keep the signature only when the producing account == the serving account (valid, and it hits the upstream prefix cache / continues interleaved thinking), and strip it before going upstream on any cross-account or untagged (foreign/historical) signature — removing the 400 + retry round-trip before it happens. SelfHeal remains a backstop. Grounded in a 2026-07-20 read-only investigation + same-account replay experiment: load distribution is even, sticky hit rate is 95%, and the 400s are caused by cross-account replay, not thinking blocks themselves.
🎨 The "Disabled" status badge is now red across admin and user portals (new .badge-disabled; key .key-tag-disabled switched to the destructive palette) for consistent styling on account cards, key cards, and the user center.
